app.title: Safe Lock-free Primitives with iceoryx2's ByteAtomic
app.author: elfenpiff
app.description: ByteAtomic is a safe lock-free wrapper around atomic operations on a single byte. It allows you to build lock-free, thread-safe data structures using only byte-wide locks.
proposed_tests: Install ByteAtomic and run unit tests
Build a lock-free data structure using ByteAtomic
